subtasks.title: Move Projects sidebar to the left, coexisting with New Task
subtasks.prompt:
Implement PLAN.md in full: relocate the Projects sidebar from the right edge of the board to the far left, so it coexists with the New Task sidebar. This is a pure webview layout change touching exactly two files.

1. src/mainview/App.tsx — reorder the flex children inside `<div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1">`. Cut the `<ProjectsSidebar projects={projects} onChanged={...} />` element from AFTER `</main>` and paste it as the FIRST child of that flex row, immediately before `<NewTaskForm ... />`. Resulting child order must be: ProjectsSidebar, then NewTaskForm, then `<main>`. Leave NewTaskForm and `<main>` otherwise unchanged. Props to ProjectsSidebar are unchanged. No import changes.

2. src/mainview/components/kanban/ProjectsSidebar.tsx — flip the panel from right-edge chrome to left-edge chrome (mirroring NewTaskForm):
   a. Outer `<aside>` cn(...): change `border-l border-border/60` -> `border-r border-border/60`.
   b. Collapse `<button>` className: change `absolute -left-2.5 ...` -> `absolute -right-2.5 ...`, keeping the rest of the class list identical.
   c. Toggle chevron icons: swap so `collapsed ? <ChevronRight className="size-3.5" /> : <ChevronLeft className="size-3.5" />` (expand rightward when collapsed, collapse leftward when expanded). Both icons are already imported.
   d. Update the JSDoc block (~lines 31-36) and the inline comment (~lines 109-111) to describe a LEFT-side panel: border on the RIGHT edge, toggle straddling the RIGHT edge into the gutter between it and the New Task sidebar; "Collapsed -> ChevronRight to expand rightward; expanded -> ChevronLeft to collapse leftward." Keep the "Mirrors the New Task sidebar's collapse-to-rail chrome" line.

Do NOT change: the widths (w-11/w-72), the clip-layer overflow-hidden div, the collapsed rail [writing-mode:vertical-rl] label, PROJECTS_PANEL_COLLAPSED_KEY persistence, or any project add/rename/delete/branch-naming logic. Do NOT touch NewTaskForm.tsx, panel-collapse.ts, or any API/server/shared-types file.

Verification before you call it done: `bun run typecheck` must be green, and `bun test src/mainview/lib/panel-collapse.test.ts` must still pass. Per PLAN.md there is no new unit-testable pure logic and the repo has no React/DOM render-test harness, so no new test file is expected — this is JSX reordering plus className/comment edits, with collapse-persistence already covered by the untouched panel-collapse test.
